name: bitinz-compress-action
description: GitHub Action: compress PNG, JPG and WebP images with the Bitinz API

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// Bundled by esbuild from src/; do not edit."
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
